page.overview:
What is Naraj?

Naraj was a group of planets in the Known Universe. It was forcibly absorbed into the Atreides Empire during the Conquest of Naraj, a battle of Muad'dib's Jihad in which the Naraj defenders activated a Stone burner Scytale recognised a song popular on the Naraj worlds.

The Tleilaxu Face Dancer Scytale, while undercover as Zaal, told Farok that, in his youth, he and a group of Face Dancers had toured the Naraj worlds.

During Muad'dib's Jihad, Jihadi crusaders took control of the Naraj worlds in the Conquest of Naraj. During the battle, the Naraj defenders used a Stone burner, an outlawed atomic device which had the side effect of decimating the eye tissue of those in a certain range. Farok's son was too close to the device and was blinded during the battle. He was nursed to health on the planet and fathered children, but returned to Arrakis in hopes of winning a Fremen wife.
